name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_parkinson_s_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.

name: patient_hoehn_and_yahr_scale_score_value_recorded_now_withunit_none
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's Hoehn and Yahr scale score as recorded now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured Hoehn and Yahr scale score if a numeric measurement recorded now is available.

name: patient_can_independently_walk_distance_value_recorded_in_meters
meaning: Numeric value representing the maximum distance in meters that the patient can independently walk.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how far the patient can independently walk.
when_value: Set to the maximum distance in meters that the patient can independently walk, as documented or assessed.

name: montreal_cognitive_assessment_score_value_recorded_withunit_points
meaning: Numeric value representing the most recent Montreal Cognitive Assessment score for the patient, in points.
when_unknown: Set to null if the Montreal Cognitive Assessment score is not available, not documented, or cannot be determined for the patient.
when_value: Set to the most recent recorded value of the Montreal Cognitive Assessment score for the patient, measured in points.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_co_morbid_conditions_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of comorbid conditions.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of comorbid conditions.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of comorbid conditions.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of comorbid conditions.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_co_morbid_conditions_now@@severe
meaning: Boolean indicating that the comorbid conditions diagnosed in the patient are severe.
when_true: Set to true if the comorbid conditions diagnosed in the patient are severe.
when_false: Set to false if the comorbid conditions diagnosed in the patient are not severe.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the comorbid conditions diagnosed in the patient are severe.

name: patient_has_finding_of_physical_activity_barrier_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has any barrier or contraindication to physical activity.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has any barrier or contraindication to physical activity.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have any barrier or contraindication to physical activity.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has any barrier or contraindication to physical activity.
